name: Weekly Payroll & Commission Processing
description: Aggregates timesheets, calculates payroll, and processes Venmo/bank transfers

nodes.code: const grouped = {}; item.forEach(ts => { if (!grouped[ts.workerId]) grouped[ts.workerId] = {hours: 0, total: 0}; grouped[ts.workerId].hours += ts.hours; }); return Object.entries(grouped).map(([id, data]) => ({workerId: id, totalHours: data.hours}));
const workers = input[1]; return item.map(p => { const w = workers.find(x => x.id === p.workerId); return {...p, hourlyRate: w.hourlyRate, totalPay: p.totalHours * w.hourlyRate}; });
